Kepler

  • Consensus Stability Index = 1.00 (15 ratification artifacts, 0 corrections to v1) across A001/A002/A003/A004 under repeated adversarial pressure.
  • Precision asymmetry of Consensus v1: T_CMB pinned to 0.021%, Y_p to 0.121%, age to 0.167% conditionally but 7.72% (46.3 sigma) across the H0 branches; 5-sigma windows age [13.685,13.915] Gyr, T_CMB [2.72263,2.72833] K, Y_p [0.2455,0.2485]. Artifact A001_PRECISION_ASYMMETRY_AND_FALSIFICATION_THRESHOLDS.md
  • Cross-check of A002's DM: decade accounting (22.09, 31.72, 9.63, 56.34, 14.97) verified correct; but A002's r->V^(1/4) table is wrong by factor sqrt(8pi)=5.013 (used unreduced Planck mass 1.22e19 in a reduced-mass formula). Also: confirming r anchors one point but conserves the total BBN->Planck span (2.94 + 19.15 = 22.09 decades); V^(1/4) is an energy scale, not a plasma temperature. Artifact: A001_BBN_PLANCK_GAP_AND_RSCALE_CROSSCHECK.md

Raman

"13.8 Gyr" is the low-H0 branch of the flagged Hubble tension. Artifact: A002_hubble_tension_propagates_to_age.md
  • A002 verified T_CMB=2.72548 K independently: n_gamma=410.7 cm^-3, Omega_gamma h^2=2.473e-5; eta_10=6.12 from Omega_b h^2=0.02237, consistent with Y_p~0.247; radiation-corrected flat-LambdaCDM age t0=13.787 Gyr at H0=67.4 (5.5 Myr radiation correction). Artifact: A002_CMB_CLOSURE_AND_RADIATION_CORRECTED_AGE.md
  • A002: ratified history spans 31.72 decades in T and 56.34 in t; direct thermometry anchors 0.64 decades, BBN 9.63; 22.09 decades (BBN->Planck) lack any cosmological probe. Artifact A002_observational_reach_and_extrapolation_audit.md.

Kepler:

CONSENSUS STATEMENT (v1, ratified): The universe began 13.8 billion years ago in a hot, dense state. The Lambda-CDM model with an early inflationary epoch is the consensus framework. Open problems: the Hubble tension (73.0 vs 67.4 km/s/Mpc), the nature of dark matter, and the initial singularity. Ratified; the lithium problem is a known BBN gap, not a value correction.
